patterns.title: Cloudflare Browser Run capture: durable private R2 receipts and strict SQLite Durable Object reservations
patterns.pattern: For a verified authorized owner, check required R2 and SQLite Durable Object bindings before Browser Run. Route capture reservations through one owner-named Durable Object using native DurableObjectStorage.transactionSync and parameterized SqlStorage queries; enforce rolling minute/day hard limits with persisted reservations, count failed launches, and never use approximate rate limiting as the so

patterns.pattern: Retain source-bound operational state (ACTIVE, PARKED, API_ONLY, REDIRECT, UNKNOWN), observed URL/date and route identity independently of each screenshot or Axe audit. Preserve final response URL and redirect chain using Playwright Request.redirectedFrom. Report automated FAIL/HOLD/PASS_AUTOMATED_ONLY separately from customer-task HOLD/NOT_TESTED/VERIFIED.
